title: Carry authoritative Purchase Order cost into stock-in movements
description: Close the audited Purchase StockIn cost-source gap by deriving base-unit movement cost from an authoritatively linked Purchase Order line only when product, unit and currency semantics are unambiguous. Preserve the existing weighted-average fallback when evidence is incomplete. Do not rewrite historical inventory, add production schema, invent exchange rates, execute SQL, or touch production data.
acceptance_criteria: An approved StockIn uses its persisted authoritative Purchase Order linkage to locate a uniquely compatible order line before using the order price as movement cost.
Package-unit Purchase Order prices are normalized to the inventory base unit using the existing UnitsPerPackage rule without changing posted quantities.

Foreign-currency prices are used only when an existing authoritative conversion to inventory cost currency is available; otherwise the existing fallback remains in effect and no exchange rate is invented.
Missing, duplicated or ambiguous order-line matches retain the documented existing weighted-average fallback rather than selecting an arbitrary price.
Cancel, unaudit and retry paths preserve movement reversal and idempotency behavior and do not rewrite historical movements.
Unit/integration tests cover unique linkage, package conversion, ambiguous product lines, unavailable currency conversion, fallback and reversal; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Approve a StockIn with one authoritative Purchase Order line and verify its base-unit movement cost source.
Approve a StockIn with ambiguous or unsupported currency linkage and verify the documented fallback is used without an invented conversion.

human_gate.reason: Repository application logic and non-production tests only; no schema execution, historical rewrite, production database access, deployment or release.
